description: A 'Sent from my iPhone' line appears mid-message, followed by several authored lines. Signature removal MUST only remove a short trailing block, so the authored lines below it MUST survive.

input.text:
Quick update before my flight.
Sent from my iPhone

Correction now that I have landed:
The vendor call is moved to Wednesday.
The budget cap is $8,000, not $10,000.
Please update the tracker.

mustContain: The vendor call is moved to Wednesday.
